The '''mother''' of [[Alara Galir]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Enok Galir]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] at their [[CZ-198]] research facility. Alara's father was consumed with guilt over the weaponized [[Flesh Raider]]s that Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]] had ordered Galir and his fellows to create, and sent an apology message to his daughter and wife asking for forgiveness, believing that he would never see them again.<ref name="Sorry" />
